title: Network: a fourth site theme, its section family, and The Group's Collective with five chapters
detail:
Owner ask 2026-10-13: build The Group (June An's San Diego business community) as a Collective with its chapters as member Spaces, put its events on the calendar and its merch in the store, write every page, and add the handoff's theme to the Frequency theme library as "Network", applied to The Group's website. Follow-up the same day: "Do MANY passes on the theme to make sure it's exactly like the Design System."

SHIPPED 2026-10-13: `network` SiteThemeId (label Network, Modern font set on a synced Space page, Marigold accent default) and the live `Network` editor theme with its theme-contract entry (lib/theme/site-style.ts, lib/sites/editor/*); the palette in four schemes, Marigold, Ocean, Lagoon and Coral, chosen by the owner's accent, plus the pops, tag colors, sand, shapes, waves and motion as one token block (lib/theme/network.ts; the subtle text step moved one shade per scheme to clear AA on the fill); the skin over the house chrome and the page sections (components/sites/network-css.ts); Bricolage Grotesque, Outfit and Instrument Serif on the website root only (components/sites/network-fonts.ts; Caveat is the root layout's); sixteen Network section blocks registered on the website surface (components/page-editor/blocks/network.tsx) with one client island, the countdown; a full-bleed `own` plan kind so a themed block family draws its own band and a Network hero owns the page h1 (lib/sites/menswork-page.ts, components/sites/menswork-page.tsx). The Group: scripts/seed-the-group.mts and its generated scripts/seed-the-group.sql (one idempotent transaction) create the Collective `the-group` on the Network theme, five chapter member Spaces (La Jolla, North Park, Oceanside, North County, Veterans; South OC is a forming circle until its details are confirmed), twelve member-led circles, the Free / Basic / Premium tiers, the three Incubator Studios offerings, four merch products with sizes, and 77 event rows from The Group Portal export (13 recurring series as RRULE anchors with their first 60 days, the rest dated) tenanted to the Collective and hosted by their chapter; six website pages and a Home per chapter, every word from the handoff's site content or written to its voice. Photos and the logo in public/brand/the-group. Fidelity: test/the-group-site.render.test.tsx renders every page through the real chrome and sections; screenshot passes against the handoff's Homepage at 1440 and 390 closed the measured differences (type scale, leading, card shadows, date tiles, bands, waves, footer). NOT applied to production by this PR: the owner runs scripts/seed-the-group.sql, and websitePublished stays off until June confirms the open items (North Park, Oceanside and South OC details, Lisel's spelling, the Most members badge, team emails, the podcast channel URL). Every portal event is seeded, the overnight 12/12 Divine Mother Journey included (owner ruling 2026-10-13).
